name: GearDex
description: Tracks camera gear inventory, shoot plans, maintenance and lending for photographers, with a scoped Studio REST API of 35 operations over gear, shoots, analytics and bookings, plus signed webhooks.

skills.name: Gear Inventory
skills.description: Create, list and update camera gear records through the Studio API's Gear endpoints, including documents attached to each item.

skills.name: Shoot Planning
skills.description: Read and manage shoot plans via the Shoots endpoints, covering the gear assigned to each scheduled production.

skills.name: Maintenance Tracking
skills.description: Log and query servicing and repair history for tracked gear through the Maintenance endpoints of the Studio API.

skills.name: Gear Analytics
skills.description: Pull usage and cost analytics over tracked gear and shoots from the Studio API's Analytics endpoints.

skills.name: Lending And Bookings
skills.description: Track lent-out equipment and booking records using the Lending and Bookings endpoints of the Studio API.
